content: {"reasoning":"The denial is CO-197 (missing prior auth), and this payer offers neither retroactive authorization nor peer-to-peer, so those actions would violate published rules. Resubmitting clean/with records or correcting data would not cure a missing auth and would just add wasted touches. Billing the patient is improper since the auth failure is provider liability under a Medicare Advantage contract, and write-off is premature with 125 days of timely filing left. The only legitimate path to recover the full allowed amount is a formal appeal arguing medical necessity, supported by reasonably strong documentation (0.85).","action":"appeal_with_necessity"}
